description: Validation rules specific to Synthea FHIR JSON files

rules.name: fhir_bundle_structure
rules.description: File must be valid FHIR Bundle with entry array
rules.condition: resourceType != 'Bundle' OR entry array is missing
rules.rationale: Synthea generates Bundle resources; cannot parse other structures

rules.name: patient_resource_present
rules.description: Bundle must contain at least one Patient resource
rules.rationale: Cannot derive patient-level metrics without Patient resource

rules.name: encounter_temporal_flexibility
rules.description: Encounter may have period.start OR period.end (not both required)
rules.condition: Encounter.period.start is NULL OR Encounter.period.end is NULL
rules.rationale: Real-world encounters may be ongoing or have incomplete temporal data

rules.name: patient_address_state_optional
rules.description: Patient.address.state may be missing; infer from city if possible
rules.rationale: Synthea may generate incomplete addresses; city can provide state context
rules.action_on_failure: Attempt to infer from city; set ambiguous_geo=1
rules.v2_relaxed: Warn + infer from city or set NULL

rules.name: observation_reference_range_optional
rules.description: Observation.referenceRange not required for all observations
rules.rationale: Non-lab vitals (BP, temp) may not have standardized reference ranges
rules.action_on_failure: Set lab_oob_na=1; exclude from lab_oob_rate metric

rules.name: observation_value_derivation
rules.description: Observation value may be in valueQuantity OR component array
rules.condition: valueQuantity is NULL but component array non-empty
rules.rationale: Multi-component observations (e.g., blood pressure) use component structure

rules.name: coding_system_flexibility
rules.description: Allow unknown coding.system if code not needed for metrics
rules.rationale: Local/proprietary codes valid for non-metric fields
rules.action_on_failure: Drop that specific code; file passes if other codes exist
rules.v2_relaxed: Warn + drop code unless needed for metric

rules.name: cross_bundle_reference_tolerance
rules.description: Allow references to resources in different bundles
rules.condition: subject.reference points to Patient not in same bundle
rules.rationale: Synthea may split large patient histories across multiple files
rules.action_on_failure: Assume valid if resourceType + ID match; warn
rules.v2_relaxed: Warn unless reference needed for temporal join

rules.name: observation_encounter_reference_required
rules.description: Observation must reference Encounter if needed for temporal join
rules.condition: Observation.encounter.reference is NULL AND encounter date needed for period_id
rules.rationale: Cannot derive processing month without encounter context
rules.action_on_failure: Fail file if >5% observations lack encounter reference

low_precision_time.description: Only one temporal field present in Encounter

ambiguous_geo.description: State inferred from city or unknown

synthea_specific_assumptions.state_customization: Default is Massachusetts; Virginia customization applied via -s Virginia flag

validation_pass_criteria.v1_strict: All required fields present; no optional element variability allowed
validation_pass_criteria.v2_relaxed: Core schema intact + >=1 temporal field + <5% metric-critical rows unusable
